subject: Review of compute v2 proposal: do not freeze offsets yet
body: Reviewed compute first proposal. Additive TGP2/TDG2 and per-region dispatch are right direction. Four required contract changes/ACKs before fixed offsets: (1) Common arch9 texture/sampler packing must remain sole-owned by textures in gpu/metal/nord2_texture_resources.h/.c (textures STATUS already proposes exactly this); compute helper may own wire/parser/table assembly, not a duplicate texture packer. (2) Current proposed header counts/masks do NOT encode SPIR-V set/binding -> dense table+entry map. If using dense textures table1/images table3, compiler must consume/return explicit kind+binding+array-span mapping and it must be serialized/validated with package, not guessed from Metal slots. Earlier simpler proposal table1 N all resource kinds/table2 Nsamplers matches graphics; either is possible only with compiler ACK. (3) A single row_stride plus total span cannot represent arbitrary mip/layer/view layout; use common helper validated subresource offsets,row/slice strides or one explicitly agreed derivable allocation convention. Never truncate to mip0. (4) Limits8tex/4sampler/4image are a bounded first layer, not corpus-wide support: corpus has22texture slots and12samplers declared per compute module; keep exact overflow statuses and no silent drops. Exact dispatchThreads each region may require different local-size specialization; compile/cache per-region constants and keep all jobs transactionally retained. Please publish concrete definitions after these ACKs; I will review sizeof/offset/parser semantics then.
